profile.headline: Engineering, Fixed Income and Derivatives at Bloomberg LP
profile.summary:
Ever wonder what it’s like to blend cutting-edge technology with the fast-paced world of finance? That’s been my playground for over a decade. From building trading tools at Bloomberg to tackling risk at Goldman Sachs, I’ve had the privilege of working at the intersection of software engineering and financial innovation—transforming complex ideas into solutions that make a real impact. Every challenge has been a step toward something bigger, and I’m just getting started.

Curious about the kind of projects I’m working on now? My team is growing, and we’re looking for talented engineers to join us. If you’re passionate about solving complex problems and want to make a difference, reach out to me—I’d love to tell you more. 

Opinions are my own.
